newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus hospital deaths were murder - police.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus hospital deaths were murder - police.

text.p: Cypriot police said on Thursday a psychiatric hospital patient was suspected of murdering two fellow patients and attempting to kill a third.
"We have received a confession concerning two murders and one attempted murder," police spokesman Glafcos Xenos told Reuters.
In one week in August, two male patients were found strangled with bedsheets at the psychiatric hospital in the Athalassa suburb of the capital Nicosia.
Both deaths were considered suicides until staff found another patient strung with a bedsheet from a ceiling fixture but still alive, who claimed a fellow patient had tried to kill him.
